speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome to the clinic. I see you are presenting with postmenopausal bleeding and an adnexal mass; to determine the cause, could you tell me your age and when your last menstrual period occurred? Additionally, how long has this bleeding and the mass been present?

speaker: Patient
text: 65-year-old woman. The patient presents with a 2-month history of intermittent postmenopausal bleeding. She denies any recent weight loss, fever, or changes in bladder or bowel habits. No previous history of similar symptoms. She has no history of serious illness and takes no medications regularly.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Endometrial hyperplasia or endometrial carcinoma (primary differential given age and bleeding). I have already asked about the mass in my first question; to confirm the nature of the adnexal mass, please confirm if it is painful or if you have any family history of ovarian or breast cancer. If you cannot provide that, I will proceed with requesting a Transvaginal Ultrasound and Pelvic MRI.
